key.name: tiling-enabled
key.description: Whether the extension should manage normal windows on the active workspace.

key.name: gap-size
key.description: Pixels between tiled windows and columns.

key.name: column-width-percent
key.description: Width of a newly created scrolling column as a percent of the monitor work area.

key.name: default-layout-mode
key.summary: Layout mode new workspaces start in
key.description: Bounded splits (bsp) or scrolling columns. Each workspace can be toggled at runtime with the toggle-layout-mode shortcut.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Log retile activity, suppressed retiles, skipped placements, and crowded tiles to the journal for troubleshooting.

key.name: scrolling-focus-mode
key.description: Fit scrolls only enough to reveal the focused column; center always centers it.

key.name: single-column-full-width
key.description: Use the full work area when only one column remains, preserving its chosen width for when another column opens.

key.name: wrap-focus
key.description: Continue at the opposite end of the strip when no adjacent monitor can receive focus.

key.name: animation-duration
key.summary: Layout movement animation duration in milliseconds
key.description: Animate horizontal and vertical moves in both layouts. Zero disables movement animations; the system animation setting is also respected.

key.name: toggle-floating
key.summary: Toggle the focused window between tiled and floating

key.name: toggle-split
key.summary: Toggle the focused split between horizontal and vertical (BSP)

key.name: resize-width-decrease
key.summary: Decrease the focused tile or column width

key.name: resize-width-increase
key.summary: Increase the focused tile or column width

key.name: toggle-layout-mode
key.summary: Toggle the active workspace between split and scrolling layout

key.name: stack-window-left
key.summary: Merge focused window into the column to the left (scrolling mode)

key.name: stack-window-right
key.summary: Merge focused window into the column to the right (scrolling mode)

key.name: move-window-new-column
key.summary: Move focused window to a new column

key.name: equalize-ratios
key.summary: Reset all split ratios on the active workspace to 50/50

key.name: cycle-column-width
key.summary: Cycle the focused column through width presets (scrolling mode)
